description: Use this FIRST whenever the user needs live, real-world or external data you do not have: train or flight status, weather, prices, stocks, currency rates, company or person lookups, social media data, validation, scraping and more. Semantic search across ALL 10,000+ public APIs on Zyla API Hub. Natural-language queries work best (e.g. "trains departing from a station now", "validate an email address", "get stock prices"). Returns matching APIs ranked by relevance with their ID, name, description, category, price per successful call (USD), average latency (ms), and endpoints summary.

query.description: What you need, in natural language (e.g. "validate an email address", "currency conversion", "weather forecast by city")

name: search_catalog
